project.name: Nalar Hakim
project.audience: Pembaca esai, telaah dan bedah hukum
readerJobs: Mengetahui posisi dalam artikel panjang tanpa kehilangan fokus

evidence.claim: Five published long-form articles include references and headings.

selections.why: Long-form articles benefit from a subtle indication of remaining reading.
selections.readerBenefit: Locate progress without opening another control.
selections.implementation: Passive scroll and requestAnimationFrame; 3px noninteractive CSS transform at viewport edge; article-bound geometry; no library.
selections.stateSource: Scroll position between article start and end of article-content, minus viewport height.
selections.sourceDescription: Lazarus Scroll Director S01 implementation recipe
selections.rejectionConsidered: S09 parallax and S13 text disclosure interfere with long-form reading and lack an evidence need.

fallback.noJs: Full article, references, navigation and anchors remain.
fallback.mobile: 3px at top, no pointer events; disabled on desktop.

rejectedAlternatives.reason: Decorative movement does not help legal reading.
No delay or hidden words permitted.

qa.environment: Chromium CI; screenshots and geometry; human inspection pending
